theory: The unrestricted facts about totals across the top/bottom and up/down opposite sides are misleading for the inward-step figures included here. State that, when tracing the boundary consistently, total rightward length equals total leftward length and total upward length equals total downward length; clarify this tracing direction in step 2 and in solutions that say sides 'point' a particular way. Also qualify horizontal/vertical orientation and distinguish right-angle turns from reflex interior angles: rectilinear figures can be rotated and can contain $270^\circ$ interior angles.
